findings.finding: qualification.qualifies_at_all_q -- the documented gate-12 primitive -- defaulted to enforce_gate_9=True, i.e. the peer-dependent gate 9 evaluated at every binding q, which is exactly the interpretation Authority Amendment 2 superseded. The production scan opted out explicitly, so the materialized cohort was correct, but the entrypoint was fail-OPEN: any other caller reached v1.4 semantics without asking for them.
findings.repair: Default changed to False (the amended per-candidate scope) and threaded into both the binding-q and diagnostic-q evaluations; the stale v1.4 docstring rewritten. Cohort byte-identity re-verified end to end by B.1.

findings.finding: test_cohort.py carried a module-level pytest.mark.skipif on the presence of the materialized cohort. Group A must have zero skips; had the artifact been absent, about thirty named group-A checks would have silently vanished from an A2 run while the receipt still read 'zero failures'.
findings.repair: A missing cohort now raises at collection time. It is a required A1 artifact, so its absence is a failure, never a skip.

findings.finding: The task graph names no A1 task owning the A3 storage preflight, the artifact-inventory stage-exit checker, the adjudication coverage checker, or the deadline plan selector and attrition branch -- yet B.7, B.8, B.10, B.11, B.12 and B.13 bind all four at A2.
findings.repair: Implemented as minimum complete frozen modules: storage_preflight.py, artifact_inventory.py, adjudication.py, deadline.py. The adjudication matrix is parsed from the hashed authority markdown rather than hand-copied, so it cannot drift.

findings.finding: assert_claim_within_rung refused 'calibrated' only where an individual rung's prohibition list happened to enumerate it. Rungs 5, 6 and 7 did not, so 'a calibrated belief state' was accepted at rung 5, against authority 28's headline rule that only rung 4 ever licenses it.
findings.repair: Explicit cross-rung rule added; D.15 and D.25 assert it.

findings.finding: cohort_build.py and bprime.py module docstrings still described the superseded v1.4 candidate bound (200 / indices 0..199). Behaviour read CANDIDATE_INDEX_BOUND_PER_DIRECTION = 2000 throughout; only the prose was stale.
findings.repair: Docstrings corrected to the frozen v1.5 bound.

findings.finding: Four EXPECTED_ARTIFACT_INVENTORY.json rows are required_before_next_stage with a NULL missing_blocker (three B-GEN III-B provenance artifacts and the B-LOCK closure receipt). A null must not read as permission to exit the stage.
findings.repair: stage_exit_check fails closed under PROVENANCE_BINDING_MISSING for those rows; B.10 asserts both branches. No scientific value changes, so this is not an amendment trigger, but it is a defect in the inventory worth naming for the next authority pass.

findings.finding: The 75-vs-76 named-check discrepancy is internal to the HUMAN authority: section A2 says '12 group-B checks -- 75 named checks', while section 11 and the controlling test plan both say B = 13, total 76, and the plan enumerates B.1 through B.13. The machine authority carries no group counts, so there is no human/machine disagreement of the kind that triggers AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT_REQUIRED; the 75 line is a residual predating the v1.3 R2 repair that added B.13.
findings.repair: Resolved to 76 and recorded in this receipt.

findings.finding: EpisodeManager.buildArenaIfChanged and conditions.arena_cache_key compose the same fields in the same order with the same separator, but render floats differently (Java double toString vs Python repr). The authority requires the material to be part of the cache identity (C07), not byte equality across the seam, and the Python key is a receipt/spec artifact rather than the runtime key.

assert_claim_in_scope matches a claim to a row by substantive-token subset and refuses the never-established list plus each row's prohibited phrases. A claim that restates a permitted row AND appends an unlisted extra assertion would pass. No textual gate can close that.
findings.repair: The never-established list is the hard backstop; B.11 tests both directions.

seam_evidence: gate 9 is evaluated once on the production cohort at the III-A q = 0.05 and excluded from the per-candidate gate-12 scope (D.4, B.1)
no III-A module imports any III-B module, and no III-A lifecycle state references a B-* state (D.26)
the arena cache key binds condition identity AND material identity in both the Java runtime path and the Python spec path
the forbidden generators (cumsum, noise-before-drift) are reachable only from negative-control call sites and tests
D.11 reproduces the frozen tau-only rho = 0.0905724833 to ten significant digits and Var(r_hat) = 351.0; D.6 reproduces the frozen unnormalized S(tau) error 9.289005120649563e-10 exactly

F-01 (BLOCKER): added p0_analysis.py and wired the complete frozen P0 analysis into run_p0_rve_calibration.py --execute. The runner captured 252 units and returned; seven of A4's eight outputs had no producer and A4's exit condition P0_SELECTION_RECEIPT was unreachable. --execute is now one transaction through stage closure, and --analyze re-closes A4 from an already-captured campaign.

F-02 (HIGH): capture_p0_unit now emits the frozen WALL_MATERIAL_CHANGE probe across a material transition, and verify_unit_liveness requires it when one occurred instead of excluding the kind unconditionally.

F-03 (HIGH): added capture_evidence.py. Frame tick identity now comes from the mod's client_tick.jsonl, dimensions from the PNG IHDR chunk, and read_succeeded from capture_complete.json. verify_frame_dimensions refuses any record not marked OBSERVED_PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE.

F-04 (HIGH): the untracked v1.5-bound capture_schedule.json naming white/lime/blue was removed from the operational capture path and dispositioned; run_production_capture.py resolves --ladder through p0_analysis.load_selected_ladder, which admits only a genuine A4 P0_SELECTED_LADDER at P0_PASS under the current authority.

F-05 (HIGH): AUTHORITY_FREEZE_COMMIT set to the v1.6 freeze a1f5dd1; it held v1.5's freeze, making current and predecessor provenance degenerate. The frozen authority was correct and was not modified.
F-06 (HIGH): both JVM stdout pipes are drained by daemon threads; nothing read them after startup, so the campaign would have blocked on a full OS pipe buffer with no blocker code.

F-07/F-12/F-17 (MEDIUM/LOW): the mandatory liveness probe is now a controlled toggle issued BEFORE the measured slots; the warmup is actually sent; dry-run evidence carries a distinct shape and cannot be persisted as a measurement.
F-08 (MEDIUM): server replies are parsed, so a mod REFUSED response raises P0_CANDIDATE_ID_UNSUPPORTED or P0_PLACEMENT_GROSS_ERROR instead of surfacing 180 s later as TIMING_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH.
F-09 (MEDIUM): stage_exit_check_fs stats the real filesystem through an explicit path-alias table; the previous check compared caller-supplied strings and its only test was tautological.
F-10 (MEDIUM): a failed capture unit is marked ATTEMPTED and the state saved before the error propagates, satisfying A4's 'all attempts retained'.
F-11 (MEDIUM): wait_for_frames waits on capture_complete.json with drained=true and writer_errors=0 rather than on a file count.

F-13/F-14/F-16 (LOW): output_root is honoured for the drained apparatus logs; the duplicated COHORT_SALT_AUTHORITY_SHA256 definition was removed; the module-scoped cohort skip now fails instead of silently dropping the frozen capture-order group.
